purpose: This table provides cleaned, typed hourly ASOS weather observations for the three NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) for January through June 2013, feeding downstream joins to flight-level tables on origin and recorded time.
usage: Join on origin_code and recorded_at (or recorded_at truncated to hour) to flight records; consumers must handle nulls explicitly in wind_dir, wind_speed, wind_gust, and pressure rather than assuming zero or average values, and should be aware wind_gust is null in roughly three-quarters of rows.
limitations: Pipeline metadata columns were dropped entirely; year, month, day, and hour remain as separate local-time integer columns rather than a single DATE because the cleanup mechanism available here cannot merge multiple source columns, so consumers needing a single date/time key should prefer the recorded_at (UTC) column; wind_gust (74.6% null) and pressure (11.5% null) are sparsely populated and were not imputed.
